svg.title: Sprint planning, time and capacity: how the pieces fit — SoftTrack web design mockup (#237)
svg.desc: A sprint adds up points and draws the burndown, and nothing says what each person can carry, how much of a ticket is left, what one person did in a week, or what the sprint was for. The epic adds a timer and hour estimates on a ticket, a weekly timesheet and sprint capacity, and a goal, a retrospective and WIP limits on the board.
svg.text: Sprint planning, time and capacity: how the pieces fit
· the numbers a plan is made of

g.text: What the work cost, and what is left of it.
Start, stop, and the worklog writes itself.
Hours beside points. Remaining against logged.
What one person did, and what each can take.
My logged time across teams, by day.
Assigned against what each person can carry.
What the sprint is for, and where work piles up.
Written when it is planned; looked back on when it ends.
A column says when it is full.

svg.text: Time logged is a team’s own. What it costs in money is finance’s question, behind finance’s flag.
first, in either order: they stand alone
Principles: points stay, and hours are offered beside them per team; totals come from the database; a column over its limit and a person over capacity are shown and the move is
still allowed; time logged is a team’s own. Each piece has its own mockup on its issue, #266 to #271.
